subject: english-language
source_note: Topic structure follows the Edexcel International GCSE IGCSE English Language (Spec A) specification. Connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (exam boards do not publish these).

connections.why: Analysing non-fiction writers' techniques models the persuasive and structural choices students make in transactional writing
The close-reading skills built on non-fiction transfer to the literary analysis demanded by the anthology
Studying anthology writers' craft gives students models for their own imaginative writing
Both writing tasks develop control of voice, structure and accuracy across different purposes
Awareness of how real writers shape language for effect feeds directly into original imaginative composition
